protocol.buffer: Excluded from training; evaluated after freeze for full-path diagnostic coverage; not untouched new evidence
protocol.limits: One repeatedly studied photograph. Re-splitting does not produce independent new-image evidence.
protocol.reserved: Previously revealed R296 reserved cases; excluded from R297 optimization, retrospective checks after final model freeze only
protocol.training: R296 training observations reused; all are development evidence
protocol.validation: Explicitly used in weighted selection, not independent evaluation
